messages:
Maya R: ok handing off now — I was driving the P1 (inference-api west1) for the last 45m. customer-facing 5xx spike (503) around 18:15 UTC, partial recovery but still elevated error rate. leaving notes below and passing primary to Alex P. @Alex P please take driver, @Chris L handle comms if you can. :wave:

IncidentBot: [INC-2026-04] Severity: P1 — 503 spike on /v1/generate in west1. Affected customers: list attached (sensitive). Pager triggered 18:12 UTC. Current error rate: 18% 1m, latency p95 2.3s. Runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/inference-503

Maya R: quick summary of what I did:
- rotated traffic to canary model variant rwd-lite-2026-02 to reduce mem pressure
- flushed prefix cache on affected hosts 
- observed one host with repeated OOM in the logs (kube node: gw-west1-07) — moved it out of the pool
- notified SRE infra to reprovision if it spikes again

Alex P: taking driver. thank you maya. first quick checks: tail the host logs and look at 503s correlated with `upstream_busy` or `k8s eviction`

Chris L: I can take comms. will draft initial customer note and post to #incidents after we confirm stable baseline for 10m. any customers with active support tickets to ping directly?

Maya R: two enterprise customers on phone, I left context in their tickets (CS-4217, CS-4220). told them we're performing failover and will update.

Sam K: noted gap — no east1 oncall until 19:00 UTC, if this migrates east we might be thin. Is there an available secondary who can cover east region if needed?

Alex P: good call. Sam, can you stand by as regional secondary? I’ll handle driver ops and Chris does comms. If east1 gets hit, we’ll initiate cross-region fallback to eu1 per runbook.

OncallRotationBot: reminder: Alex P is scheduled as primary for 18:00-02:00 shift. Sam K is secondary until 20:00.

IncidentBot: notable logs snippet (aggregated):
```
2026-03-15T18:12:37Z gw-west1-07 inference-gateway ERROR upstream_busy: queue full -> 503
2026-03-15T18:12:42Z gw-west1-07 kernel WARNING oom_killer invoked
2026-03-15T18:13:01Z gw-west1-08 inference-worker INFO model_served rwd-large-2026-02 latency=220ms
```

Alex P: next steps I'm running: allocate extra pool instances in west1 (scale up +3), pin traffic to rwd-verified-medium, collect `curl -v https://api.redwood/v1/health` across hosts, and keep an eye on memory pressure. I’ll paste commands and outputs here.

Alex P: running scale command now:
```
# scale west1 inference pool
kubectl scale deployment inference-pool-west1 --replicas=10 -n inference
# quick health check
for h in gw-west1-0{1..9}; do echo $h; ssh $h "curl -sS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code} %{time_total}\n' http://127.0.0.1:8080/health"; done
```

Maya R: small note — when you scale, leave the node drain script off until new nodes are healthy, otherwise we risk cascading evictions. also double-check kernel parameters for `vm.overcommit_memory` (we saw aggressive OOM earlier).

Chris L: draft for customers: "We're investigating an increase in 503 errors impacting inference calls in the west1 region. We're actively mitigating, have moved traffic to a stable model variant and are scaling capacity. We'll update in 10 minutes or when we have a stable baseline." Want me to send now or wait?

Alex P: wait 10m and confirm p95 < 800ms and error rate < 1%. If we hit that, send the note and mark incident state as 'mitigated' for customers but keep open internally for postmortem.

Sam K: I'm monitoring logs and ready to execute east1 fallback if necessary. If we need to move traffic, prefer graceful route policy, not hard cutover. Also ping infra to pre-warm instances in eu1.

Maya R: handoff checklist:
- primary driver: Alex P (accepted)
- comms owner: Chris L (accepted)
- secondary/regional cover: Sam K (standing by)
- runbook link: https://redwood/runbooks/inference-503 (see steps 1-6)
- outstanding: infra reprovision for gw-west1-07, CS tickets updated

Alex P: accepted. I'll keep the bridge open and will post a short summary after 30m. ping me in thread if anything urgent.

Chris L: ack, will prepare customer message and queue for send once Alex confirms stability. :eyes:

IncidentBot: status update @1738801290 — error rate down to 2.1% in last 1m, p95 latency 1.1s. Monitoring.

Maya R: thanks all — handing off officially now. :thumbsup:

Alex P: received handoff. taking ownership. starting to collect logs and will post periodic updates.

Chris L: copy. drafting message and will hold until Alex confirms.

Sam K: standing by for escalation.

OncallRotationBot: handoff logged: outgoing=Maya R, incoming=Alex P, time=1738801234.

Alex P: last: committing to these concrete next-checkpoints: 18:25 confirm p95 < 800ms, 18:35 confirm error rate < 1%, then we consider closing customer-facing incident.

Chris L: noted. I'll aim to send the first customer notification if we meet 18:25 threshold.

IncidentBot: final log snapshot at 1738801350 attached.
